raw_text: Bhai exact same thing happened to me. Had saved Rs 15,000 across 5 months. Friends planned a trip to Manali, so I redeemed the fund. Once money was withdrawn I didn't feel like restarting the SIP. (comment #812)

TradingQ&A thread summary: My father saw my Groww app and got furious when he saw equity mutual funds. He has the 2008 crash trauma and made me cancel all my SIPs and open an SBI Recurring Deposit instead. How do first-time young investors handle family pressure when markets fluctuate? (comment #841)
ValuePickr discussion note: App is great for starting, but after 8 months there is zero motivation to continue. You just stare at a static chart. Stopped my SIP last week. (comment #688)

ValuePickr discussion note: Is it normal to feel regret after 5 months of SIP? I put in 5k every month diligently. Market had a minor 4% correction and all my gains vanished into negative. My elder brother said 'SIP is a scam created by AMCs to collect expense ratios'. Almost tempted to hit the redeem button. (comment #846)

Comment from personal finance video: I stopped my SIP at Month 10. Not because I lost money, but because I had zero feedback on whether I was on track for anything. Investing feels completely lonely and robotic. There's no celebration when you hit 10 consecutive months without failing. (comment #397)

Comment from personal finance video: PSA: Groww mandate bounce charge is brutal. My company delayed salary disbursement by 3 days because of bank holiday on 1st. My SIP debit date was 3rd. Result? Mandate failed and SBI charged me Rs 295 penalty! For a 1000 rupee SIP, paying 295 fine is ridiculous. Why doesn't Groww have a pre-debit balance verification or 48-hr grace period? Stopped all SIPs immediately. (comment #968)
